en: A black‑and‑white historical street scene shows a gently curving cobblestone road lined with narrow multi‑story townhouses on the right and an older, massive round corner building with a tiled roof in the center foreground. On the left is a small ivy‑covered cottage. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the street and a few carts or small vehicles are visible in the distance. At the far end of the street rises a distinctive town‑hall‑like tower with several tiers and a clock. The overall look suggests a Central or Eastern European old town. No obvious modern elements appear, and there is no clearly legible text.
